places.name: Odie B's
places.description: Fast-moving sandwich spot with one of Denvers best burgers.
places.why_it_hits: Not just a burger place, but you should look past the Double OD burger.  Save exploring the menu for your sencond visit.  The OD burger is a double smooshed patty with american and cheddar jack, dill-ppickled onions, and fancy sauce on a brioche bun.
